test_datasets.prompt: [Exo view] **Scene Overview:** The scene is a kitchen featuring a light grey granite countertop. The backsplash is composed of white rectangular subway tiles. Above the countertop, there are white painted upper cabinets with recessed panel doors and silver-colored handles. Below the countertop, there are dark grey painted lower cabinets, also with recessed panel doors and silver-colored handles. A stainless steel gas range with four burners and stainless steel control knobs is centered on the backsplash. Above the range, a stainless steel range hood is installed, on which a small, stylized, silver-colored chef figurine is positioned. To the left of the range, a stainless steel sink basin is partially visible. A window showing green foliage and blue sky is present in the upper left of the frame. On the countertop to the right of the range, a stainless steel espresso machine with an attached coffee grinder is visible. Various kitchen items are present on the countertop: a cream-colored ceramic pitcher, a blue ceramic teapot with a lid, several white ceramic bowls of varying sizes, and one white ceramic mug. A block containing several kitchen knives with dark handles is visible next to the espresso machine. A white and red striped linen kitchen towel is draped over the handle of a lower cabinet drawer to the left of the range. A large rectangular wooden cutting board occupies the central foreground on the countertop, below which two red fabric oven mitts are stacked. **Action Analysis:** The action sequence commences with the person's right hand positioned with its fingertips slightly inside the opening of a light brown wooden salt cellar, appearing to retrieve a substance. Simultaneously, the person's left hand grasps the lower cylindrical body of the wooden salt cellar and wooden lid, stabilizing its position on the wooden cutting board. The movement transitions as the right hand, with its fingertips now containing a visible quantity of white granular material, withdraws from the salt cellar, moving upward and slightly forward. The left hand maintains its grip on the wooden salt cellar and wooden lid, lifting it slightly from the cutting board. Following this, the right hand elevates further and pivots, positioning itself directly above a stainless steel pot containing an orange liquid. The fingertips of the right hand then begin to open, allowing the white granular material to fall in a stream into the pot. The left hand continues to hold the wooden salt cellar and wooden lid, supporting it below the right hand's trajectory. This action of releasing the white granular material into the pot continues as the right hand maintains its open fingertip posture, allowing a consistent stream to descend into the orange liquid within the pot. The left hand remains steady, holding the wooden salt cellar and wooden lid at a consistent distance from the falling material. Elements are inferred from the exocentric view. Directly in front and slightly below the viewpoint, a stainless steel pot containing an orange liquid is visible. As the action transitions, the right hand is observed pulling upwards and slightly forward, its fingers now visible and containing a small quantity of white granular material, having withdrawn from the wooden salt cellar. The left hand maintains its grip on the wooden salt cellar and wooden lid, which is now positioned slightly higher.
